Subject: Notice of Third-Party Patent Assertion re: EdgeModel

Jordan —

Attaching a formal notice we received this morning alleging infringement of U.S. Patent No. 11,234,567 related to "multi-query attention routing". We were asked to preserve evidence and to provide recipient contact information for indemnity purposes.

Files attached: complaint.pdf, claim-summary.docx

Immediate asks:
- Please confirm whether Redwood elects to defend/indemnify under the MSA/order form terms (we've pasted the relevant clause below).
- We will need a primary legal contact and an expected timeline for a proposed response.
- We also need to discuss privilege handling for technical materials — GlyphTech records are privileged and we expect to treat our deliberations as privileged as well.

Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

— S. Park

legal@glyphtech.com

- Eng (Ben): can you triage the claim and pull any relevant model usage logs / training artifacts; flag anything that should be redacted for privilege.

Proposed reply to GlyphTech by EOD Fri (48 hrs): confirm receipt, confirm we are evaluating coverage, and request a call next week to align on evidence exchange.

If helpful, call 2pm PST today?

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of Third-Party Patent Assertion re: EdgeModel

Jordan / Ben —

Quick read-through: the allegation appears to implicate features delivered under Order Form DL-4821. Under section 9.2 (Customer Indemnity), GlyphTech is asking Redwood to assume defense for third-party claims for IP infringement. We should verify whether the accused functionality is part of a Redwood-hosted model variant we provided, or a customer-supplied artifact.

Proposed legal approach:
1) Coverage check (immediate): I will run a coverage matrix against the MSA + order form. If coverage is triggered, we notify GlyphTech that Redwood will coordinate defense per the contractual process.
2) Privilege protocol: we should offer a staged evidence transfer: (a) high-level technical recitation (non-privileged) to satisfy claim triage; (b) privileged materials only on an attorney-to-attorney basis under NDA and marked privilege; (c) privilege log for any docs withheld.
3) Redlines suggestion: attach redlines-msa.docx and orderform-redline.pdf — these are candidate language changes we may propose on the follow-up call to clarify notice & cooperation obligations (keep these offline for now).

Ben — can you assemble the tech-evidence.csv with logs, model hash IDs, and deployment manifests by EOD Thu? Mark anything that is attorney work-product.

Irene — please coordinate with Legal Ops on any insurance notice requirements. Also, we need to confirm whether our indemnity includes subrogation carveouts.

I’ll draft a constrained reply to GlyphTech that acknowledges receipt, confirms we are evaluating coverage, and proposes an attorney call Mon/Tues next week. Give me any comments before I send.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[Attachment: redlines-msa.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of Third-Party Patent Assertion re: EdgeModel

Team —

Triage complete (initial). Summary below; full CSV attached as tech-evidence.csv.

- Impacted deploys: two prod pools (redwood-edge-a, redwood-edge-b) running model variant edgemodel-v2.1 between 2027-11-01 and 2028-07-30.
- Evidence items collected: model checksums, inference logs (sampled), deployment manifests, API request traces (anonymized).
- No customer-supplied code found in the implicated path — runtime components are Redwood-managed.

Privilege flags: several email threads between eng and legal include strategy commentary — will mark those for attorney review. I redacted user-identifying tokens from the CSV.

Attachment: tech-evidence.csv

Next steps from eng: put evidence on secured drive and share link with Kimberly/Irene attorney-to-attorney, with privilege markings as needed. Happy to be on the call next week to walk through technical timeline.

— Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
